811.text: These four characteristics, inseparably linked with each other, indicate essential features of the Church and her mission.
811.notes: Second sentence only (the first names the Church one, holy, catholic and apostolic). Was proposed 2026-10-06 to ground 'the four marks of love'; that ruling was reversed 2026-10-07 (facets kept, memory.html Future Task 167), so the book does not use it for this.
